context:
Goal: a repo's git hooks are always the ones on main.
Problem (risk): banchi checks that its armed hook copy matches main; the shared installer does not, so a stale copy can sit unnoticed in other repos.
Based on (incident): banchi 2026-09-01, hooks unarmed for 4 days (plan, banchi row 21).
Based on (read): the plan names githooks/main-ref/install.sh as the shared home; no lane yet.
Departs from: githooks/main-ref/install.sh, which does not check the armed copy — it refuses a copy behind main.

lastAnswer.note: Owner pick a, 22:23 CST. Lane hook-installer-armed-copy builds it (coordinator 22:24 CST).

options.gain: No repo runs stale hooks for days unseen.
options.how: New lane: the shared installer's check refuses an armed copy that differs from main; banchi removes its zeroth rule.
options.label: Promote to the shared installer
Keep it in banchi only
options.lose: Other repos can run stale hooks unseen.

ref: docs/plans/child-guard-promotion.md on PR #1119 (ea66d8e), owner question 4, banchi row 21
title: Should the shared main-ref hook installer refuse an armed hook copy that is behind main?
why: The incident cost 4 days unguarded and every repo installs the same hooks.
